references.text: The prophecy of the Messiah suffering in silence, which reflects Jesus' silence and suffering during the trial.
David's description of his enemies surrounding him can be seen as a prediction of Jesus' suffering and judgment.
A parallel event in Matthew where the high priest accuses Jesus of blasphemy and sentences him to death.
Luke's description of how the leaders conclude that Jesus has committed blasphemy, which aligns with the event in Mark.
The Jews' response to Pilate about why Jesus must die reflects the charge of blasphemy and the death sentence.
